title: Wrong literal in template (26 cards)
body:
- Obosh, the Preypiercer: companion requires even mana values instead of odd
- Discover the Impossible: also allows sorcery spells
- Time of Ice: stays tapped only for the next untap, not as long as you control it
- Marwyn's Kindred: conjures into hand instead of onto the battlefield
- Mists of Lórien: same name instead of same mana value
- Living Breakthrough: same name instead of same mana value
- Descendants' Path: same name instead of shared creature type
- Sugar Coat: becomes a Clue instead of a Food
- Omen Machine: moves the top of the library instead of the exiled card
- Jocasta, Automaton Avenger: adds a counter trigger on attack that the card does not have
- Ezuri, Stalker of Spheres, Scheming Aspirant and Venser, Corpse Puppet: limited to once each turn
- Tom, Bert, and William: return under your control instead of their owner's
- Enter the Avatar State: adds an extra land play
- Zilortha, Apex of Ikoria: applies only to creatures with no abilities
- Earth's Mightiest Heroes: permanent enters tapped
- Head Games and Jester's Mask: hand goes on top in random order
- Fiend Artisan, Lin Sivvi, Defiant Hero and Tezzeret the Seeker: reveal the found card, which the text does not say
- Condemn: bottom of library is encoded as the owner's choice of top or bottom
- Ether Well: "you may put it on the bottom" is encoded as the owner's choice
- Taskmaster, Mercenary Mimic and Sivitri, Dragon Master: "until your next turn" ends too early or too late
